text:
Priya M: FYI follow-up from last night's outage (cloud IAM throttling -> model-registry 5xx cascade). I opened a tracker: https://tracker.redwood/actions/INC-901. Please grab items.

Diego R: grabbing the registry fallback work. plan: small in-memory LRU for model metadata + a stable on-disk snapshot for critical hashes. ETA 2026-02-08.

Kelsey: i'll own auth retry tuning + alerting. will add auth_retry_ratio metric and propose backoff. ETA 2026-02-05.

infra-bot: Created actions: ACTION-901-1 (registry-cache), ACTION-901-2 (auth-retries), ACTION-901-3 (runbook-update). Owners must update status in 48h.

Priya M: observed pattern: spikes align with credential rotation windows and registry 5xx floods; retries cascade into IAM leading to throttles. Short-term fixes: small cache TTL, strict retry budgets, and an alert for auth retry rate > 60/min.

Diego R: cache plan: TTL=25s, max_size=5k, exclude secrets and signed URLs. will add integration test that fails over to on-disk snapshot when registry returns 5xx.

Kelsey: retry snippet i'll PR:
```
initial_backoff_ms=150
max_backoff_ms=3000
max_retries=3
jitter=true
circuit_breaker=failures:10,window:60s
```
Expect this to reduce token storm amplification.

Marta G: security note  any local snapshot must be encrypted at rest and ACL'd. i'll update runbook and KMS rotation note. ETA 2026-01-30.

Priya M: owners, please add vendor ticket IDs and escalation contacts in the tracker. we'll do a 15m sync tomorrow to confirm timelines.

Diego R: confirmed and claimed ACTION-901-1. PR link added.

Kelsey: confirmed, opening vendor support case now and will paste ID.

Priya M: thanks. i'll post a short summary to the ops channel after the sync.
